description: Polytab Forecast Reputation Ledger. Non-monetary only: accuracy rate, resolution record, and badges. An entry is added only after a market resolves and that staker's forecast is verified against the resolution. No balances, no payouts, no contact details, and no location data are stored here.
payoutPolicy: none — reputation is never redeemable, transferable, or paid in money.

badges.label: First Forecast
badges.rule: Backed at least one outcome in a resolved market.

badges.label: Correct Call
badges.rule: Backed the credited intervention in a resolved market.

badges.label: Three Correct Calls
badges.rule: Backed the credited intervention in three resolved markets.

badges.label: Long Horizon
badges.rule: Forecast placed at least 180 days before the resolution deadline and correct.

badges.label: Perfect Season
badges.rule: Five resolved forecasts with no incorrect calls.
